trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened the SEV2 incident.

1. **Rollback:** The latest deploy, v2.3.1, was failing health checks in us-east, us-west and eu-west with an 18% error rate. Its staging build (v2.3.1-rc) had also failed. v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production. All three regions are now on v2.3.0, and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
2. **Incident:** INC-0001 is open as a SEV2 for checkout-api, and the on-call engineer has been paged. It describes the failing v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, that the service has recovered, and that v2.3.1 needs a root cause found before it's deployed again.
   - The first attempt to create the incident timed out. The incident list showed nothing had been created, so I tried again using the same duplicate-protection key. Only one incident exists and on-call was paged once.
